title: Zechariah
author: Zechariah son of Berechiah, son of Iddo.
date: Late sixth century B.C., after the exile.
audience: Returned exiles rebuilding Jerusalem and the temple.
historicalSetting: Zechariah encourages restoration through visions, promises of cleansing, and hope in the coming King.
keyVerse: Zechariah 9:9 — "Behold, your King comes to you... humble, and riding on a donkey."
christFocus: Zechariah points richly to Christ as the Branch, the humble King, the pierced One, and the Shepherd of God's people.
outline: The coming King and final hope — Zechariah 9-14
